## b16ee7199f81

**Finding: the generated distribution cannot teach per-cell color preservation and admits a verified color-collapse shortcut.** Every canonical input has two nonzero colors and 6–14 nonzero cells. The generator instead paints a 3–5-cell motif in exactly one nonzero color. A 24-seed probe found one color in every generated input.

Concrete rival: collapse all nonzero source colors to the most frequent color, complete the binary support by the same 90-degree rotations, then restore only the original input cells' colors. This rival is exactly equal to the canonical authority on all 24 generated probes because each generated grid has one color. It fails canonical training pair 0: color `6` is most frequent, but the intended output adds color `3` at `(3,4)`, `(6,1)`, and `(6,4)`; the rival writes `6` at those three cells. The canonical Racket authority was used for both the original and color-collapsed executions. Evidence: `checks/audit-b16ee7199f81-color-shortcut.json`.

The target also failed its current linter/override probes: declared axes are ignored or non-observable, and the override gate reported 16,020 findings. No target file was modified.

## b16ee7199f81

**Reproduced defect: single-color generated support admits a color-collapse shortcut.** Audited generator SHA: `7d31753ef559527f613b8b4b65544fc77e2a54dc57387d9ee96513eeb0abb4b2`; selected rule hash: `6a1b405a4f72`.

The current generator was sampled for 60 inputs, 20 per difficulty band. All 60 passed `self_check`, all 60 contained exactly one foreground color, and foreground cell counts ranged only from 3 to 5. The canonical examples contain two foreground colors and require preserving which color owns newly completed cells.

A plausible rival collapses every nonzero source color to the most frequent color, applies the same rotational completion geometry, then restores colors only at original input cells. That rival is identical to the intended rule on every one-color generated input. On canonical training pair 0 it disagrees at exactly three newly added cells: `(3,4)`, `(6,1)`, and `(6,4)` are intended color 3 but the rival writes color 6.

Exact reproduction and grids: `checks/audit/b16ee7199f81/reproduction.json`. Selected-rule receipts: `checks/audit/b16ee7199f81/racket_original.json` and `checks/audit/b16ee7199f81/racket_collapsed.json`. The combined audit check also found no task-local tests and no semantic contract: `checks/audit/b16ee7199f81-combined/checks/b16ee7199f81_audit_summary.json`.

This issue was present in the target's retained review index; I used that only as a lead and re-ran it against the assigned current hash. No source files for this audit target were changed.
